messages:
Aisha: Quick micro-poll — if our office needed a mascot, what would it be? pick one: 🐿️ Overcaffeinated Squirrel, 📎 Zen Stapler, 🧠 Rolling Whiteboard, or 🟨 The Eternal Post-It?
Ben: Overcaffeinated Squirrel. 100% energy, zero HR paperwork. :laughing:
Carlos: Rolling Whiteboard. It rolls away when you need it most. iconic. :face_with_monocle:
Dana: The Eternal Post-It — stick to everything, never goes away. perfect. :stickers::raised_hands:
Ellen: Zen Stapler. Calm, efficient, slightly intimidating. also would start meeting mindfulness rituals. :lotus::stapler:
Aisha: Bonus tie-breaker: what would its catchphrase be? one-liners only. GO.
Ben: "Fuel, then ship." short, direct, smells like coffee.
Carlos: "I contain multitudes (of sticky notes)." dramatic.
Dana: "Staple your problems together." instant product-market fit for HR.
Ellen: "Quietly keeping chaos aligned." brand-adjacent.
SnackBot: Heads-up: office kombucha at 30% — refills accepted. :bento:
Aisha: lol SnackBot stole the show. last rule: emoji reaction decides. react with your mascot choice emoji.
Ben: reacts with :thumbsup: (for 🐿️)
Carlos: reacts with :rolled_up_newspaper: (for 🧠)
Dana: reacts with :pushpin: (for 🟨)
Ellen: reacts with :bookmark_tabs: (for 📎)
Aisha: tally from my non-scientific eyeball vote: squirrel wins by a kibble. new unofficial mascot: Overcaffeinated Squirrel.
Ben: proud. naming ceremony when the coffee machine wakes up. :coffee:
Carlos: suggest name: "Latency". tiny, jittery, full of requests.
Dana: I call dibs on mascot plushie. petition to put it on the reception desk.
Ellen: official motion seconded. cc: @Facilities for a tiny squirrel plush procurement.
SnackBot: Noted. Filing request: `#office-mascot-procurement` (automated ticket created). :memo:
